arc-design-playground-demo.description: Live demo — change typography, spacing and layout tokens with keyboard/tap support.

arc-frats-brief.description: AIDC's attendance problem as a conventional-workflow diagram, with requirements pinned around it.

arc-frats-build.description: Team sketching capture → recognition → attendance; a red mark on the data-flow decision.

arc-frats-demo.description: Real demo screens with synthetic faces only; interactive pipeline inspection.

arc-guards-ai-workflows.description: Caption drafting, event admin automation and AI workshops — with a human reviewing every output.

arc-guards-media-coverage.description: Real published photos from the team (approved selection).

arc-imperium-wip.description: Imperium screens with visibly dummy data; clearly stamped WORK IN PROGRESS.

arc-imperium-workflow.description: Real ATW output: scans → structured analysis → trade-ready summary.

arc-jpm-visualisation-tool.description: Safe mock of the dashboard layout — no real data.

arc-market-city-renders.description: Real renders/screenshots; pointer-reactive map with demo data and an accessible list alternative. Stamped WORK IN PROGRESS.

arc-nebius-curiosity.description: Earbuds, a train window, notes on AI-infrastructure companies.

arc-nebius-price-path.description: Illustrative price path labelled "illustrative" with two red markers: entry and exit.

arc-nebius-thesis.description: Three small panels: the business catalyst; the entry criteria; the invalidation/risk rules.

arc-overflow-panel-party.description: Panel Party at NP ICT Open House 2023; sprite movement and collision highlighted.

arc-overflow-planning.description: Lesson plans, attendee lists, a room being set up.

arc-registudio-auction-house.description: Planning board: a watch price-history tracker and an art price-per-inch valuation idea. Stamped CONCEPT.

arc-registudio-packages.description: Earlier vs current offer — only if you supply real (scrubbed) pricing history.

arc-taekwondo-colours.description: Two beats: a second-place podium, medal in hand; then the Colours Award certificate.

arc-taekwondo-mat.description: A competition mat under hall lights; teenage Reginald in his dobok mid-kick, a referee's arm raised.

arc-taekwondo-third-dan.description: Reginald tying a black belt embroidered with three bars; a grading hall behind him.

arc-testimonial-dimuthu-staffroom.description: NP ICT staff room; NP-age Reginald and his mentor.

arc-testimonial-jovita-classroom.description: SST computing classroom after lessons; teenage Reginald and his teacher.

arc-testimonial-jovita-handover.description: Stylised handover; camera pivots over Reginald's shoulder to the paper reader.

arc-testimonial-keith-ace.description: The ACE room after the recruitment drive; teenage Reginald and his teacher-in-charge.

arc-testimonial-rahul-desk.description: Reginald at his desk near the end of the internship; Rahul approaches with a sheet of paper.

arc-testimonial-victor-advisor.description: An NP ICT corridor or consultation room; NP-age Reginald with his advisor, a stack of workshop slides between them.

arc-testimonial-yap-teaser.description: Concept only — 2027 parade square, Singapore flag, Reginald in uniform, Yap Shi Hao (Head of Manpower, Guards Formation) nearby. Shown as a "coming soon" teaser; no letter handed over.

arc-tya-commitment.description: Symbolic, non-identifiable tutoring room; English, Maths and Science books.

future-bench.description: A much older, imagined Reginald alone on a bench near the Singapore Botanic Gardens amphitheatre at sunset; softened red accents.

future-fade.description: Old Reginald lets out a satisfied breath; camera pulls back; colour fades to black.

future-glimpses.description: Ink-wash glimpses: studying and working in the UK, a graduation, senior leadership, cities and nature. No real university logos or certificates.

guards-ai-process.description: Illustrative diagram — caption drafting, event admin and daily-task automation, AI workshops, and a chatbot for Guards combatants. Labelled "illustrative workflow".

guards-bmt.description: Brief BMT montage with Guards-related training; fatigue creeps in.

guards-card-ai.description: Reginald working with a teammate, the two of them talking to an LLM chatbot on screen.

guards-card-building.description: Home desk at night: the Automated Trading Workflow running, Imperium and Market City sketches pinned beside it.

guards-card-discipline.description: Two compact moments: gym progression; a hand lifting a card deck off a shelf after five years, then a flourish.

guards-card-trading.description: Commute podcasts → strategy videos → a trade-tracking spreadsheet; a red ticker ribbon flows from phone to home desk.

guards-first-camera.description: Through a viewfinder, a monochrome scene snaps into a deliberate composition with a narrow red focus guide.

guards-media-team.description: Wide split scene: a planning meeting with Yap Shi Hao (Head of Manpower, Guards Formation), then Reginald directing his media team's coverage of a parade.

guards-pneumonia-transition.description: Restrained and symbolic — a corridor that forks; one path closes, a side door opens. No hospital melodrama.

hero-fracture.description: The silhouette fractures along three diagonal panel borders — foreshadowing the three present-day lives. Top nav compacts into the right-side mode dock as this panel exits.

hero-silhouette.description: Black screen; narrow red rim light reveals current-age Reginald as a crimson silhouette. `PORTFOLIO` types in above the name; ivory `REGINALD TAN` lands huge; red `陈彦杰` overlaps the centre of the Latin letters. Pose and 1- vs 2-line name chosen after the wireframe comparison (A folded arms · B close-up · C three-quarter turn).

jpm-capitaspring-arrival.description: One oversized panel: Reginald walking toward CapitaSpring, Singapore. Painterly recreation from a public exterior reference.

jpm-conference-room.description: Interns around a conference table; Rahul turns to Reginald.

jpm-fatigue-choice.description: Head in hands; a pause; then a small framed decision — one sticky note, one next step.

jpm-final-presentation.description: Reginald presenting lessons and outcomes to a panel; the screen unfolds into the milestones grid.

jpm-grafana-update.description: Left: a coworker leans over as Reginald wires their team's database into Grafana (safe mock dashboard). Right: Reginald presenting migration progress on a high-level stage board.

jpm-long-workday.description: Day-to-night match-cut at the same desk; simple clock marks. Static fallback for the scrubber.

jpm-migration-brief.description: Rahul brings Reginald to a desk beside Farhan, a fellow intern. Overlay: an abstract red route from on-premise boxes to cloud shapes — never a real architecture diagram.

np-graduation.description: Ngee Ann Polytechnic graduation ceremony, May 2025. Reginald in a graduation gown, on stage, receiving his certificate. An awards button opens a pop-up list.

np-jpm-call.description: Reginald at his home computer desk. The room drains to grey; only the phone notification is red.

np-jpm-offer.description: Reaction stays on Reginald. The red edge of the phone becomes a door/window line — match-cut to CapitaSpring after the chapter separator.

np-overflow-workshop.description: Reginald explaining a concept to peers; a partial Panel Party screen slides in at the side. Never implies he built the whole game.

np-tea-shop-frats.description: The Tea Shop's early website beside an abstract FRATS capture → recognise → attendance pipeline. A progression in complexity, not the same week.

np-tya-tutoring.description: Respectful tutoring setting, framed from behind; the child is never identifiable.

np-workshop-open.description: NP campus/studio; Reginald moves among laptops, prototypes and classmates. A small awards drawer in the corner expands on click.

present-merge.description: The three cards slide together into one notebook/code window; red drains to monochrome as a younger Reginald appears.

present-ns.description: Current Reginald with a camera in a media-planning setting at Guards HQ.

present-registudio.description: Desk with proposal drafts, a rough pipeline board and concept sketches; clients anonymous.

present-trading.description: Current Reginald reviewing a generic, synthetic market display; one red decision line; no balances or order IDs.

registudio-design-playground.description: One-off experiments snapping into reusable components; real components from the repo, not mock-ups.

registudio-first-call.description: Generic video-call UI; Reginald listening more than talking. Client anonymous.

registudio-friend-call.description: Reginald walking through Singapore city streets; phone lights up with a red line.

registudio-pipeline.description: Leads from freelance platforms, outreach and conversations flowing into an anonymised lead → meeting → proposal → client funnel. No phone numbers or names.

registudio-pricing.description: A proposal built on online agency pricing meets a budget mismatch; the lost lead fades. Next beat: Reginald rewriting an anonymised pricing/positioning board with segments and scope made explicit.

registudio-reflection.description: Reginald closes a planning notebook; the last page becomes a view of the future (time-lapse into Chapter 8).

sst-ace-drive.description: After-class ACE board planning, then the recruitment booth — flyers, a sign-up board, students queueing. Focus is on talking to people, not medals. Students anonymous.

sst-drct.description: Generic online-test UI and a ticking clock (black and white), then the real Bronze certificate revealed in muted gold with a red edge. Exit: a whiteboard line extends into the NP chapter.

sst-friends-building.description: Split frame. Left: Reginald and friends at a whiteboard and editor, building locationX. Right: Reginald alone at night, testing an NRIC validator on dummy IDs only.

sst-nric-validator.description: Reginald at a desk with his laptop; friends sitting and standing around him, shocked that the algorithm can tell a valid NRIC number from a fake one. Dummy numbers only on screen.

sst-python-classroom.description: SST computing classroom, mostly black and white. Teenage Reginald with classmates over a Python/pandas lesson on a synthetic dataset; one highlighted line of code glows red.
